Once you've added yourself to the project you can add yourself to the thumbnail! I recommend grouping your characters in their thumbnail poses before adding them to it to reduce clutter.

==== Make sure you haven't broken any of the rules below before sharing this project. If you have, fix them up or your remix may be declared UNOFFICIAL! ====
Only @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @TheDiamondDoggy, @Aydenfox8, @s-dbayer, @Kyle3912Again, @ZYellow and @chomperthegamer can break these rules! Rules marked with a (!) can only be broken by @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, nobody else! 

(!) 1. It is polite and REMIX ETIQUETTE to comment "Remixing..." in the comments before starting a remix, so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, then don't remix if someone has commented "Remixing..."!
(!) 2. DO NOT BREAK SCRATCH'S COMMUNITY GUIDELINES (SCG)!! That means nothing too scary, gory or vulgar & no inappropriate language!
(!) 3. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking rules list without permission! Furthermore, don't delete any of these rules or instructions & don't completely change the project title either!
4. Don't delete or destructively modify anything you didn't make, unless to fix a bug or glitch, modify anything that breaks any rules or the SCG, delete unused scripts, or (only if you're a rule-breaker) to add a new feature to the game.
5. Please don't try to make anyone more/less powerful and likelier to win/lose than others. Everybody should have equal chances of winning!
6. Don't make your characters too large, that would make it hard to see or make them too inaccurate compared to their hitbox. If they are too big, resize their costumes, NOT their sprite, so their hitbox remains the same size & Rule #5 isn't broken!.
7. I don't recommend adding any singular characters that appear to be 2 separate characters (EG: Mario & Luigi both as 1 player), unless they are stuck together with no feasible way to physically detach them.
8. Don't delete any music tracks unless they break the SCG. If you don't want to listen to a certain song or genre, use the "audio exemption" system to make sure you can't.
9. On the topic of music, please also refer to the Music comment's recommended music limit so this project doesn't reach the size limit too quickly.
10. You can add yourself to the thumbnail, but please don't delete any characters off it (unless they break Rule #5) or completely change it altogether.
11. If you are part of the "breaking rules" list, you're allowed to add a new rule if needed. Remember to add it to both the RULE RECAP comment and the project's instructions!

Oh, and don't delete this comment either. (!)

KO!: Screaming & shouting as they are blown up & knocked out of the game!
HitScreen: A muffled grunt the character makes if they manage to slam into the project screen when KO'd.
Win!: The character's victory phrase for when they outlast all the others and win the game!

3K-Z!Bny*?A!?6,i/H-=.text:
Due to the winter-theme of this AY-minigame spinoff, it's recommended all the music you add has a winter-themed tinge to it, with chilly airy-sounding instruments, sleigh bells & similar winter-like instruments being played, and an overall cold snowy feeling. All of the get-ready jingles & gameplay music you add should also have scary and/or dangerous vibes to suit the perilous mood of the gameplay. (results music can be positive though). If you want to add your own music, first separate your song into it's intro (if it has an intro) and it's looping part in separate sounds, tag "-Start" at the end of the intro's name, then tag "-Loop" at the end of the looping part's name. (Jingles won't have these tags, as they aren't intended to loop.) Add the song's name into either "Add music" block, depending on what scenario it should be for, & finally drop it here! Remember that EVERYTHING must be correct spelling or else it won't work! If you're unsure, testing is recommended.

If the music track or jingle comes from a party game, like Mario Party, Wii Party or WarioWare: MEGA Party Game$, make sure it won't play for users who don't want those music tracks, like SmashBrosFan2020, via the audio-exemption lists & boolean. Same goes for "gets faster" tracks, lyrical music, Flash-game tracks & non-looping music. Burgnew_On_A_Laptop recommends you please don't add any more than around 80 music tracks and jingles total, to prevent lag or the dreaded "refusal-to-save glitch" when modifiying the project on less powerful devices. It's also best to refrain from adding too many music tracks longer than 3 minutes (180 seconds) or too many "gets faster" tracks.
